name: Snukk
description: A goblin who vowed halfway to the target of a fling that he had been tricked for the last time.

description_citations.text: Planechase 2012: card flavor text (Planechase 2012, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Snukk is flung toward a target and vows he has been tricked for the last time.
timeline.quote: About halfway to the target, Snukk vowed that he had been tricked for the last time.
